name: Tater Tot & Meatball "Cheeseburger" Skewers with Thousand Island Dip (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).

Place beef, bread crumbs, egg, Worcestershire, and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a tablespoon measure, form beef mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb lean ground beef
¼ cup panko bread crumbs
1 egg
½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: When the oven is heated, add tater tots to one half of the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven and bake for 12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (32 oz) bag tater tots or puffs, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry lettuce and tomatoes. Tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, then arrange in small stacks (you should have enough for 12 small stacks). Place on a plate along with 12 tomatoes. (Reserve any remaining tomatoes for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ head butter (Boston) lettuce
½ pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Stack cheese slices one on top of another, then cut into quarters.

Remove baking sheet from the oven, stir tots, and spread back out in an even layer. Add meatballs to the other side of the baking sheet, then return to the oven. Continue baking until tots are just golden and meatballs are cooked through, about 10 minutes (or cook tots according to package instructions).

When the tots are just golden, remove baking sheet from the oven and top each meatball with a mini cheese slice. Return to the oven and continue to bake until meatballs are cooked through and the cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To assemble the skewers, thread a tater tot, lettuce stack, cheesy meatball, pickle, tomato, and second tot onto each skewer.
Arrange skewers on plates, serve with Thousand Island dressing for dipping, and enjoy!
